primary.body:
https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHOAIENG-79820

## Description
Migrate distribution **host** app/build configs from webpack to rspack, following [RHOAIENG-79269](https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHOAIENG-79269) and Task A of the rspack migration epic.

**In scope for this PR:**
- Rename `frontend/config/webpack.*` → `rspack.*` (CLI was already rspack); migrate FileExplorer playgrounds
- Migrate `distributions/base`, `rhaii`, `core-bff/frontend`, and `maas-customer-portal` to `rspack.*` configs/scripts
- Align plugins/deps with rspack (`HtmlRspackPlugin`, `rspack-merge`, VirtualModules where needed); prune unused webpack-only app-build deps
- Keep core-bff Cypress on webpack preprocessor
- migrated to rspack 2.10.0 which contains the newly released architecture bindings which allows us to move off of our custom built bindings
- updated the frontend webpack references and performed file renames to align

**Out of scope:** federated remotes (Task B), docs-only PR (Task E), upstream notebooks/model-registry (Tasks C/D)

## How Has This Been Tested?
- Local `frontend` `start:dev` via rspack-dev-server (compile + type-check succeeded)
- Local `distributions/maas-customer-portal` `npm run dev` via rspack
- Suggested additional checks before merge:
  - `frontend`: `npm run start:dev` / `npm run build:prod`
  - `distributions/base`, `rhaii`, `core-bff/frontend`: `start:dev` + production build
  - Confirm core-bff Cypress webpack preprocessor still wires as before

## Test Impact
Build/tooling migration only — no product UI behavior changes. Updated one unit test assertion for rspack-related error wording (`routeErrorUtils.spec.ts`). New unit/Cypress coverage is not applicable for bundler config renames; Cypress webpack preprocessor intentionally unchanged.

## Request review criteria:

Self checklist (all need to be checked):
- [x] The developer has manually tested the changes and verified that the changes work
- [x] Testing instructions have been added in the PR body (for PRs involving changes that are not immediately obvious).
- [x] The developer has added tests or explained why testing cannot be added (unit or cypress tests for related changes)
- [x] The code follows our [Best Practices](/docs/best-practices.md) (React coding standards, PatternFly usage, performance considerations)

After the PR is posted & before it merges:
- [ ] The developer has tested their solution on a cluster by using the image produced by the PR to `main`
